Length of the first deck section that broke free, feet

references.what: the bridge's deck mid-twist, seen from the side, big caption on top

thumbnail.pattern: the hits show the bridge itself mid-twist as the whole cover with a few big words; ours shows our 3D deck mid-twist with three words on top

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Wind tore the Tacoma Narrows Bridge apart. How?

place: over the grey water of the Narrows beside the twisting suspension bridge
the wind gauge on the east tower

moments.what: the green suspension bridge over grey water, its deck already rolling, quarter-span amber, date caption on; wind streaks cross the frame and a readout swings to the figure
the twist deepens, the stress climbs to amber-red
push in on the rolling deck, the bridge's name tag on
pull wide along the whole span rolling between its towers

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: It was four months old, and its builders called it Galloping Gertie.

params.place: on the deck of the bridge in summer, a car driving over the rolling road

moments.what: a car drives onto the deck in summer light, a calendar card flips JULY to NOVEMBER
workers in hard hats on the tower top, THE MEN WHO BUILT IT
back on the deck: the road ahead rises and falls in a slow wave under the car
GALLOPING GERTIE types on
the camera drops below the deck edge to its solid steel side

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The flaw: solid steel plates down its sides, like a wall. The wind couldn't pass through.

params.place: a cut-away cross-section of the deck, a general principle diagram

moments.what: the deck cut through on an archive paper sheet, roadway on top
both side plates light amber
the solid plate girder draws on, SOLID PLATE GIRDER
a red brick-wall hatch flashes over each plate, = A WALL
wind streamlines arrive from the left and pile against the plate
the streamlines are forced over and under the deck, swirls peeling off behind it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: That morning, the bouncing stopped. The deck began to twist. Why was that worse?

params.place: along the deck from beside the west tower, the hangers and the cable above

moments.what: grey morning light along the deck from beside the west tower, THAT MORNING types on
the deck rides up and down evenly
low under the deck edge, the bouncing dies away, BOUNCE STOPS
wide: the deck rolls, one edge up, one down, NOW IT TWISTS
the rolling edges flash amber

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Each twist tipped an edge up, and the wind pushed it further. It fed itself.

place: end-on view down the deck with force arrows
the loop diagram of twist and wind

moments.what: looking down the deck end-on, it rolls to one side
EDGE TIPS UP types on
a wind arrow hits the raised edge
the arrow turns red and the deck rolls further
a tilt gauge swings wider
the loop diagram draws over the darkened shot: TWIST, WIND PUSH, BIGGER TWIST
the loop spins faster and goes red

params.place: at the mid-span, the deck tearing away and falling into the Narrows, time slowed

moments.what: silence: the twisted mid-span deck fills the frame, the hangers red
the sub-boom: hangers snap in a ripple, the deck section tears free with sparks
wide: the section drops into the grey water, a white splash

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: A {fact4}-foot piece of deck fell into the water. No person died.

params.place: from the shore: the bridge with its middle gone, cables sagging, a lone car left on the stub

moments.what: a bracket spans the gap in the deck with the figure
the splash rings spread on the water under the gap
the sagging cables sway
on the shore, onlookers stand behind a rope looking up
the light turns flat grey, the stub of the deck still swinging

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Since then, long bridges are tested in wind tunnels first. Its replacement got an open truss.

place: a wind tunnel lab with a bridge model
the replacement bridge's open truss deck

moments.what: a wind tunnel with a section model of a bridge deck on springs, smoke lines streaming
the smoke lines flow smoothly over the model, a gauge needle steady
push in, WIND TUNNEL TEST
cut to the replacement bridge, an open steel truss under its deck, THE REPLACEMENT
wind streaks pass through the truss
the truss lights amber, OPEN TRUSS

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Plates or truss: which would you drive across? Gertie had the plates.

params.place: the two decks side by side over the water, then back to the twisting bridge

moments.what: the solid-plate deck section on the left in amber, SOLID PLATES
the open-truss deck on the right lights teal, wind passing through it
cars on each deck, WHICH WOULD YOU CROSS?
cut back to the green bridge, its deck starting to twist as in the first frame
